correctness.rationale: The generalized blend is algebraically reduced to a convex combination of two local lines; the three cardinal coefficients have exactly one negative coefficient on each open cell. Strict monotonicity of the derivative-sign ratio proves the unique cell maxima and strictly increasing cell-defect function, yielding a unique equal-gap global minimizer. The center critical equation has one root, and the fixed and moving mesh power limits follow from uniform tail estimates and a unique Lambert W stationary point. The packaged verifier passed 496 deterministic supplementary cases including exact Fraction identities; finite tests are not used to prove infinite quantifiers.

value.rationale: The primary generalized rational interpolation literature motivates Lebesgue amplification and mesh dependence but gives only coarse mesh-ratio bounds. The exact three-site optimized norm is a natural minimal stability invariant; equivalence to monotone overshoot identifies extremal data and the necessity of balancing the interior site. The sharp mesh-power law quantifies a real design tolerance (displacement of order 1/gamma) and shows a noncommuting high-power versus asymmetric-mesh limit; these are substantive structural stability facts rather than a routine substitution or unmotivated numeric slice.
